feeds.title: Minding the Workplace
feeds.description: Minding the Workplace, hosted and written by David Yamada, is dedicated to news and commentary about work and employment relations. Dignity at work, workplace bullying, employment & labor law, and psychologically healthy work environments are its recurring themes.

feeds.title: Anti-bullying, all together against harassment between students
feeds.description: Anti-bullying, all set against harassment between students - This blog is dedicated to the fight against violence and harassment in schools. Together we can make a difference.

feeds.title: OvercomeBullying.org Bullying Blog
feeds.description: OvercomeBullying.org Bullying Blog keeps you informed about new additions and features on our site. The blog will provide information and resources to help you deal with the workplace, school, community, and cyberbullying.

feeds.title: STOMP Out Bullying Blog
feeds.description: The leading anti bullying nonprofit, STOMP Out Bullying is dedicated to changing student culture, reducing & preventing bullying, cyberbullying & other digital abuse. Learn more.

feeds.title: Brainstorm Productions
feeds.description: Brainstorm Productions aim is to reduce the incidences of bullying in schools and improve student behaviour and wellbeing. Explore our blog for articles on a range of student wellbeing topics, including online safety education and bullying in Australian schools.

feeds.title: Bullying of Academics in Higher Education
feeds.description: Authored by Pierre-Joseph Proudhon, The bullying of academics follows a pattern of horrendous, Orwellian elimination rituals, often hidden from the public. Subscribe for the latest updates from this blog.

feeds.title: Your Life Matters Empowerment Alliance
feeds.description: We are a United Nations Global Marketplace Bullying Prevention Nonprofit Organization Vendor, in which our vision and mission is to offer our services as future United Nations Ambassadors in our own community centers strategically placed around the world.

feeds.title: Net Family News
feeds.description: Tech Intelligence for Parents with cyber-bullying and anti-bullying information with videos.

feeds.title: End Bullying
feeds.description: Northern Ireland Anti-Bullying Forum. Acting together to end bullying.

feeds.title: Generations Against Bullying Blog
feeds.description: GABnow's purpose is to prevent bullying in our community through education and awareness. We provide educational programs and resources to individuals, families, educational institutions and organizations. We make available online learning and educational resources in order to help people deal effectively and positively with the act of bullying and its long-lasting negative consequences.

feeds.title: TheEmpoweredEmployee
feeds.description: Blogger for targets of workplace bullying. My name is Janice and I hold a BA in Psychology and am affiliated with the Workplace Bullying Institute.

feeds.title: Savvy School Counselor
feeds.description: Hello, and welcome to my school counseling blog! My name is Vanessa, and I have been an educator since 1991. Savvy School Counselor blog is created to connect with school counselors around the globe to share ideas, techniques, literature, and much more.

feeds.title: Stop Workplace Bullies…Now! Blog
feeds.description: This blog is a resource for information to help people recognize the signs and symptoms of a toxic workplace, and to make people aware of the health-harming effects of workplace bullying.

feeds.title: Jeff Veley's Blog
feeds.description: Expert insight for grownups featuring advice for parents, educators, & mental health professionals. Jeff Veley is a youth motivational speaker who specializes in resilience education for bullying prevention. Follow for his articles, interviews, and advice on bullying, parenting, and teaching.

feeds.title: Bullies Be Gone Blog
feeds.description: Stopping Bullies at Home and Eliminate Workplace Emotional Abuse. How to create a bully-free environment in school, at home, at work today by Ben Leichtling.

feeds.title: Cyberbullying Research Center Blog
feeds.description: Discuss how to keep kids safe from online harassment and victimization on this blog. There is a related book, research, presentations, and more in addition to the blog. Recent posts are on talking to the parents of a bully and public service announcements.

feeds.title: Author Cherie White
feeds.description: A blog exposing bullies and liberating targets to make the world a safer place for all.

feeds.title: Workplace Bullying Institute
feeds.description: Proving that bullying isn't just a place for the schoolhouse is this blog. The WPI is an organization dedicated to the eradication of workplace bullying with help for individuals, research, public education, training, legislative advocacy, and solutions for employers. In addition to blog posts, you can also get sections on businesses and tools for targets.
